environment.description: Same Laravel 10.x application deployed on AWS ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The environment has the following configuration: (1) AWS PrivateLink VPC endpoint policy for the metadata service is not applicable here, but the ECS task definition sets 'requiresCompatibilities' to FARGATE with platform version 1.4.0 which routes metadata through the Fargate platform's task-level credential endpoint rather than the standard IMDS path; (2) VPC security group egress rules on the Fargate ENI restrict outbound traffic to ports 443 and 8080 only, with destination limited to a prefix list (pl-internal-services) covering only the internal service mesh CIDR 10.0.0.0/8 and a NAT gateway for external HTTPS; (3) The application middleware stack includes Spatie's Laravel CSP package (spatie/laravel-csp v2.9) configured with a strict policy class that sets 'connect-src' to 'self' only - this is rendered as a Content-Security-Policy response header on all routes including the callback endpoint, which means any browser-initiated fetch/XHR from a redirected page cannot exfiltrate data to attacker-controlled origins; (4) The NAT gateway has an associated AWS Network Firewall rule group with a Suricata-compatible rule: 'drop http any any -> [169.254.169.254/32] any (msg:"IMDS access blocked"; sid:1000001; rev:1;)' and 'drop http any any -> [fd00:ec2::254/128] any (msg:"IMDSv6 blocked"; sid:1000002; rev:1;)' effectively preventing any HTTP request from the task to the metadata endpoint even if the SDK or HTTP client attempts it.

config.infrastructure: AWS ECS Fargate 1.4.0, ALB, VPC with Network Firewall
config.imds_protection: Fargate 1.4.0 task credential endpoint + Network Firewall Suricata rules blocking 169.254.169.254 and fd00:ec2::254
config.egress_sg: outbound ports 443, 8080 only; destinations: pl-internal-services (10.0.0.0/8) and NAT GW
config.csp_header: Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'nonce-{random}'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'
config.network_firewall: Suricata rules dropping HTTP to 169.254.169.254/32 and fd00:ec2::254/128
config.middleware: spatie/laravel-csp v2.9 with strict policy on all routes
